**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 already delivers our preferred ASSIGN position:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, sale of all/substantially all assets) without Vendor consent, subject only to prompt notice and assignee assumption.
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are mutual with a not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed standard.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, plus a cooperation obligation for successor administrative changes.

A document-wide check confirmed no conflicting provision: Section 13 licence-transfer rights track Section 24, Section 9 mentions only insolvency-type general assignments, and Section 30 contains no residual assignment restriction (30.5 in fact preserves enforcement rights for permitted successors and ordering Customer Affiliates).
